label: Community starter
help: A sensible first setup: welcome messages, verification, leveling, tickets, role menus, events and giveaways.
author: lucky-edgelord
description: Switches on the modules most communities want on day one and sets calm defaults: warnings time people out, level-ups are announced, members can have two tickets open. Preview the changes before applying; a restore point is saved first, so you can undo it.

config.welcome.message: Welcome to {community}, {mention}! Say hi, and have a look at the rules.
